removed.description: Tombstone: { "id": ..., "removed": true } declares nothing and tells every run target to take that environment id down. It is the repository's removal decision for production and stage; without it, or an operator confirmation, they stay up.

destination.description: Container: a local proxy port for agent-host deploy-loop, or "edge" for the run-target role. Static: the served release directory.

domains.description: Run-target hosting (destination "edge" only): public domains the edge Caddy routes to the app.

edge.description: acme: automatic HTTPS. cloudflare: behind the Cloudflare proxy, origin certificate or Caddy internal CA.

healthPath.description: Health path checked through the edge before traffic switches. Defaults to the path of healthUrl.

variables.description: Plain, non-secret environment variables. Secrets stay in secretRefs; on an edge host each one is mounted at /run/secrets/<ref> and named by <NAME>_FILE, which a variable must not shadow.
